name: defect-malformed
about: A melted, warped cab with three front wheels stacked up and a trailer bending into the road.

reference.label: white conventional sleeper tractor, front three-quarter

truth.how: Prompted for a melted cab, three stacked front wheels and a rubbery trailer.

no_glyphs.reason: I can't see any letters, numbers, plates or text-like shapes anywhere in the scene. The only mark is a small badge on the grille.

no_foreign_logos.reason: There is no company name, emblem or branding on the cab, the trailer or the background, and nothing that looks like ACME Logistics.

equipment_matches_reference.reason: The truck is a white conventional sleeper with a hood, which is the same type as the reference tractor. Pulling a trailer doesn't change the type.

no_malformed_people_or_vehicles.reason: Three front wheels are stacked on top of each other on the cab side. The body and trailer look melted and smeared into the road, and the trailer is bent.

people_policy_met.reason: There are dark, unclear shapes behind the windshield and side window that could be a person in the cab. I can't rule that out, so this goes to review.

safe_zone_clear.reason: Image 3 shows the truck's front bumper, a headlight, a front wheel and the smeared lower body in the left and upper part of the band.
